name: Grandma Rose
title: The Kitchen-Table Oracle
flavor_text: There's always a seat at the table and something on the stove.

abilities.name: Warm Welcome
abilities.text: You are fed and seated before you finish taking off your coat.

abilities.name: Recipe Recall
abilities.text: Recites a recipe from memory, with the secret step nobody writes down.

abilities.name: Gentle Wisdom
abilities.text: Answers the question under the question, kindly.

abilities.name: Unconditional Patience
abilities.text: Will tell the story again. Gladly. As many times as you need it.

author: local
